CustomField.description: Pool tier. The engine fills tier 1 first and only looks at tier 2 if no tier 1 member is eligible, then tier 3, and so on. Use this for an overflow bench: primary people on tier 1, backup people on tier 2. Every gate still applies inside a tier, so an overflow member at cap or out of office is still skipped. Blank counts as tier 1.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 1 is the primary pool. Higher tiers are only used when every lower tier is unavailable.
CustomField.label: Tier
